alt: Close-up of a dark blue paramedic uniform bearing a badge reading 'ALTA PARAMEDIC HEALTH' with a generic corporate mountain logo
story: Alberta secretly rebranded its 3,500-paramedic Emergency Health Services to 'Alta Paramedic Health' — spending $25,000 on prototypes without telling any staff — until the Health Minister personally ordered it stopped after a wave of public backlash.
why_funny: The new badge looks indistinguishable from a supplement brand or yoga studio, which is exactly the wrong vibe for the people you're calling at 3am.
